quest.title: Bake-Danuki Wanderlust
quest.description: A bake-danuki seems to be looking for help on Pudding Isle...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? What's a bake-danuki doing on this island?

dialogues.speaker: Mamesuke
dialogues.text: Mm... Shibasuke...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Did that bake-danuki speak?

dialogues.speaker: Mamesuke
dialogues.text: Eek! Yellow Fur and... Flying White Fur?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! You're just like Kichiboushi! Anyway, it's not Flying White Fur. The name's Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Mamesuke
dialogues.text: Paimora? Paimora knows Kichiboushi? Paimora, amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not Paimora, Paimon...! So, Kichiboushi is that famous now, huh? His training must be going well!

dialogues.speaker: Mamesuke
dialogues.text: Bye... mon...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, forget it... Wait! Why are we suddenly able to understand bake-danuki?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ioroi once mentioned that bake-danuki can understand humans, but we can't understand them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We could understand Kichiboushi before because we'd had a bake-danuki meal, but its effects didn't last that long...

choices.text: These islands have always been really unusual.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... It's almost like nothing strange is strange here!

response.speaker: Mamesuke
response.text: Mm... Shibasuke can't find...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh... Paimon's getting confused. You mean you're Shibasuke, and you're searching for something?

response.speaker: Mamesuke
response.text: Mmm... Dumb White Fur...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So you got separated from Shibasuke. Is that it?

response.speaker: Mamesuke
response.text: Mm! Smart Yellow Fur! Mamesuke grateful!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph, Paimon's got this one! It says its name is Mamesuke!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ooh, bravo. Bye-mon bravo.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}! You too!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, how did you get here, Mamesuke?

response.speaker: Mamesuke
response.text: Playing with Shibasuke on unfamiliar boat.

response.speaker: Mamesuke
response.text: Sleepy... Woke up! Lots of people!

response.speaker: Mamesuke
response.text: Lots of wind on fists.

response.speaker: Mamesuke
response.text: Big cold person.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That sounds mighty like the Fatui.

response.speaker: Mamesuke
response.text: ...The Fatty?

response.speaker: Mamesuke
response.text: Leave ship and wait in cave. Fatty leave.

response.speaker: Mamesuke
response.text: Shibasuke find way home, mountain kaboom!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mountain kaboom? Oh! Is he referring to the mountains switching...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #What do we do, {NICKNAME}? Are we responsible for Shibasuke going missing?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, guess we'll have to take responsibility and help Mamesuke search.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, but how? ... Oh, Paimon knows what to do! Let's look for clues with your <color=#00E1FFFF>Elemental Sight</color>!

choices.text: What do you mean "we"? All I hear are bake-danuki noises.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Has some strange ability awakened within Paimon? Is Paimon the Tanuki Whisperer now? ... Nah, that can't be it!

talks.objective: Use Elemental Sight to look for clues

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's a leaf that contains the power of Anemo. Huh, speaking of those...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's a leaf from the Mondstadt-styled mountain...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, but now a leaf covered in Anemo has found its way to an Inazuma-styled mountain, and Shibasuke is missing. That means...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Shibasuke might be on the Mondstadt-styled mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, since we've found a clue, let's head back to Mamesuke!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're back!

dialogues.speaker: Mamesuke
dialogues.text: Shibasuke?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well... We haven't found Shibasuke yet...

dialogues.speaker: Mamesuke
dialogues.text: Mmmm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey! Cheer up! We may not have found Shibasuke, but we've found a clue! Right, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, we just need another mountain kaboom.

dialogues.speaker: Mamesuke
dialogues.text: Mountain kaboom!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... We can't leave you alone here, Mamesuke, so come with us!

dialogues.speaker: Mamesuke
dialogues.text: Mm!

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: Yellow Fur kapow! Fly high, can't learn... Mm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You can't? Oh well, but this still counts as a way to enter a wind current...

dialogues.speaker: Mamesuke
dialogues.text: Wow! Not purple Lavender Melon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's a Sunsettia. Actually, both of them grow on Cuihua Wood, but the fruit varies according to the location!

choices.text: Maybe it has something to do with soil and climate.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, it's thundering all day over there in Inazuma...

response.speaker: Shibasuke
response.text: Flaming grass there! White Fur! Hurry!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Flaming grass... Oh, you mean Flaming Flowers!

choices.text: Maybe it's a Dendro Slime on fire.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, that is possible... Let's go take a look!

choices.text: It might be a Pyro Whopperflower.
Maybe it has something to do with Archon preferences.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Would Ei enjoy a Lavender Melon? It's pretty hard to imagine that happening...

talks.objective: Change the stone formation on the right side of the bonsai to Leisurely Rocks
Look for Shibasuke on the mountain

dialogues.speaker: Mamesuke
dialogues.text: Mountain kaboom! ...Shibasuke?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Isn't that Mamesuke? What's Mamesuke doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: Eek! White Fur! Shoo!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Is that Shibasuke? It looks just like Mamesuke...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The bake-danuki of Inazuma are really difficult to tell apart...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Except Kichiboushi. He sure stands out from the crowd!

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: Kichiboushi? Lie!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We took Kichiboushi to train all across the lands! We were there when Ioroi told Kichiboushi to never stray from the tanuki path, you know? Hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: Ioroi? White Fur lie! Shoo!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... You're Shibasuke, right? Stop trying to get rid of us, Mamesuke sent us to find you.

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: ...Mamesuke? Really?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Of course! Come with us. Mamesuke is waiting for you!

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: Hmph! White Fur lie?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Argh! He's so infuriating! He would be bake-danuki paste now if it wasn't for us!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They both look the same, so why is Shibasuke so stubborn...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew... that was difficult. We should have asked Mamesuke for proof.

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: Steal?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Gah, Shibasuke is so suspicious of everything.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A little vigilance never hurts when you're out of doors.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Come on, Paimon's super friendly-looking.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But the bake-danuki of Inazuma should be skilled at transforming. Shibasuke could've transformed into a butterfly or something and flown away just now, right?

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: Hmph! Dumb White Fur! Bake-danuki transformation not easy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? But bake-danuki who can transform into things like barrels and lamps can be seen all over Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: Mmm, not same.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How is it different?

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: Mm... White Fur talk too much! Won't understand...

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: Where Mamesuke...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like Shibasuke isn't willing to talk anymore... Let's just take him back to Mamesuke!

dialogues.text: Body heavy... Mm!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Mamesuke! We brought Shibasuke back!

dialogues.speaker: Mamesuke
dialogues.text: Mm! Shibasuke!

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: White Fur no lie! Mamesuke! Yey!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So Shibasuke didn't really trust us until now...

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: Mountain so fun! So many new things! But no Lavender Melon...

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: Almost became bake-danuki paste too, so close.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hehe! You're lucky we arrived in time, eh, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: Hmph.

dialogues.speaker: Mamesuke
dialogues.text: Mm! Thanks Yellow Fur, White Fur!

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: Mamesuke go too! Furry grass! *blow* Bald!

dialogues.speaker: Mamesuke
dialogues.text: Wow! Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Furry grass? You mean the Dandelions?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? But how will you get back to Inazuma? The Fatui ship? Paimon doesn't reckon you can go back the same way you came.

dialogues.speaker: Mamesuke
dialogues.text: ...Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh brother, Paimon doesn't think they've even considered that. {NICKNAME}, we can take them back to Inazuma, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We can take them with us when we leave.

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: Go later?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Later?

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: Want to see furry grass with Mamesuke.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... So we'll come back a little later, then?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon doesn't know how much of Mondstadt's charm they'll be able to experience on these islands, but making them Mondstadt-styled islands is probably the best we can do.

talks.objective: Change the stone formation on both sides of the bonsai to Leisurely Rocks

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mamesuke is still in the mountains! If we switch the mountain styles now, finding Shibasuke will be the least of our problems! Even Mamesuke might get lost!

dialogues.speaker: Mamesuke
dialogues.text: Yey!

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: Mm... White Fur, understand.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hearing that from Shibasuke feels so strange... But are they gonna be alright?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Some time later, you return to see Mamesuke and Shibasuke again...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh! It's Mamesuke and Shibasuke!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You seem like you're having fun on this Mondstadt-styled mountain! The scenery here is quite different from Inazuma, right?

dialogues.speaker: Mamesuke
dialogues.text: So much green! Wind so soft! Yey!

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: Furry grass so fun! *blows*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, if Inazuma is purple like lightning, then Mondstadt...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Is green like the wind.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh-he.

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: But there are not-purple Lavender Melons, out of reach.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? What are you talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: White Fur can fly. White Fur can get it?

dialogues.speaker: Mamesuke
dialogues.text: Mamesuke lead way! Come!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Gah, these two are so impatient. Let's follow them!

dialogues.text: #Oh, it's just a wind barrier! Hehe! We've seen many of these in our adventures across Mondstadt, haven't we, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Speaking of wind barriers, why do they vanish once the thing inside them is taken, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, the thing they're protecting is gone, so...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...That sounds kinda sad.

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: White Fur can fly. White Fur get it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh yeah... Wait! You know, you should learn to stop relying on others and solve problems by yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Mamesuke
dialogues.text: Mmmm...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It seems a little too difficult for a beginner.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Is that so? Hmph! Then experienced adventurers like {NICKNAME} and Paimon will have to teach you some lessons!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #There's Anemo Amber here, which is perfect. It'll create a wind current once destroyed. C'mon, {NICKNAME}, show them how it's done!

dialogues.speaker: Mamesuke
dialogues.text: Wow! Not purple Lavender Melon!

choices.text: Lavender Melon?

response.speaker: Mamesuke
response.text: Lavender Melon, purple, tasty!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's probably a melon from Inazuma.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Lavender Melons are Lavender Melons! They're not the same!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! The current vanished so quickly... Well, not that there's no other way to do this...

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: White Fur no fear!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! Shibasuke said that transformation isn't easy, so Paimon thought he wouldn't be good at it.

dialogues.speaker: Mamesuke
dialogues.text: Shibasuke amazing! Transform into many things! But not when afraid!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Ooh, so that's how it is! Alright then, {NICKNAME}, let's get those Sunsettias for Mamesuke and Shibasuke!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, Paimon knew it was a Flaming Flower.

dialogues.speaker: Mamesuke
dialogues.text: Flame grass so hot.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's a trick to picking Flaming Flowers! You have to extinguish them first to pick them safely.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You'll need water or ice on a sunny day, and it's even easier if there's a Hydro Amber nearby. If it's raining, just use Anemo to swirl the rain and wet it.

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: White Fur knows much, very amazing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Of course! Paimon and {NICKNAME} have learned a lot in our adventures.

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: Anemo Amber, Hydro Amber, same?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... How should we explain this... They look almost the same, but one creates a wind current, and the other creates rain.

dialogues.speaker: Shibasuke
dialogues.text: Mm!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! Shibasuke transformed into a Hydro Amber!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I kinda wish you could transform too, Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon can't do that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's help Mamesuke and Shibasuke pick the Flaming Flower...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? We've got Slimes dropping from the skies!
